title: Total Cost of AI Ownership (TCAIO) lifecycle costing
primary_chapter_title: Lifecycle Cost, Pricing, and Benefit Realization
purpose: Calculates one-time and recurring AI costs, discounted present value, cost per use, and optimistic/base/conservative scenarios across the full lifecycle.
input: `Costs` sheet with category, item, one-time cost, annual recurring cost, start year, end year, low/base/high multipliers, and budget owner; `Parameters` sheet with horizon, discount rate, and eligible volume.
outputs: Detailed annual and category cost tables, present-value summary, cost-per-use estimates, scn comparison, category chart, annual-cost chart, and summary JSON.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
